description.text: Brief Introduction There are 2 semesters in one academic year, 21 weeks for each semester. Autumn semester starts in Sept; Spring semester starts in March. Summer holiday lasts 6 to 7 weeks; Winter holiday lasts 4 to 5 weeks. Teaching Material Fee Collect the fees according to the price of that time. Pre-pay the depositCNY 3000

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Course at Hebei Medical University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1805 USD/per year ￥ 13000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.
